text.tspan: EPIC (): recompute the first K tokens
BlockAttention (): Fine-tune the model to produce a good independent cache
KVLink (): in addition, train additional tokens and recover cross-attentions
KVPacket (): Link tokens only; head+tail; prefilled offline (not during inference)
CacheBlend (): recompute K tokens that cause largest cache diff in the 1st layer
